description: To get this project to work via local hosting I used Express. To do the same follow these steps in the terminal.  1. node -e "require('child_process').execSync('npm init -y', {stdio: 'inherit'})" 2. node -e "require('child_process').execSync('npm install express', {stdio: 'inherit'})" 3. node server.js 3 ctrl + click on the localhost:3000
